Present the complete cloak in a three-quarter frontal view, centered as a single object. Show the entire collar hardware and every trailing fabric edge; leave 10–15% transparent space on every side. Genuine transparent background. One item only. Restore the missing silhouette, do not copy the crop. No detached scraps, duplicate items, scenery, shadow plate, border, frame, text, letters, or watermark.
